newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle active at $112/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle active at $112/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers turned active at midmorning, USDA said. Live sales fully $0.50 per cwt higher; dressed basis $1.00-$2.00 higher. Demand and seller interest very good.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs - live basis 68.50-69.50; dressed basis 111.00-112.00, some "calf feds" early 110.00. ( weighted average 111.39 ).
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs - live basis 69.00; dressed basis 111.00-112.00, some "calf feds" early to 110.00. ( weighted average 111.29 )
For week - 44,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 4,700 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 27,400
